protocol: WALK_FORWARD_PROTOCOL.md §5 (the learning loop): a finite, registered menu of candidate weightings, <= 12, written before the walk runs -- Amendment C (2026-09-02): plus one recalibrated item, M13, last in the list
rule: Hedge (exponentially-weighted average forecaster) over these items; weights updated from cumulative PAST SEALED scores only. Item M01 with weights never updated is baseline 4 (the frozen engine).
field_weights: uniform within a block (registered; not adjustable)
blocks: situation = the coded sr_* fields on events (today); market = derived signals observed strictly before t; physical/actors/dyads/system/narrative = the state panel blocks (PATH Steps 2-3) -- a block with no known field drops out of the distance, so items that weight those blocks are identical to their base item until the panel lands (stated, not hidden).

items.base: the frozen mixture: equal weights over M01-M12 at the same read (protocol §4 baseline 4)
items.rule: WALK_FORWARD_PROTOCOL.md Amendment C: per IES level, a monotone recalibration map fitted on the frozen mixture's earlier reads whose branch window had closed by t (identity until 40 such reads; isotonic when the level has >= 40 positives, else Platt), renormalized; P and M are the frozen mixture's
items.not_a_weighting: carries no block_weights, retrieve_min or k; never passed to the retrieval
